overview_description.description: Airwork is a platform to hire premium blue collar workers on-demand. You can get an Airwork the same way you get an Uber, except instead of a taxi, someone shows up to your business to work for the day. Airwork fills 98% of shifts in 2 hours, serving customers Tesla, the Toronto Pearson Airport, and the CNE across North America. Airwork is funded by YCombinator, Expa, Village Global, and SHL Capital.
